newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales to total $1.56 bln for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales to total $1.56 bln for Tuesday.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales for Tuesday are expected to total $1.56 billion in 40 offerings, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $258 million in 28 issues. The largest is an $87.5 million Los Angeles Municipal Improvement Corp sale at 1200 EST.
Negotiated sales total $1.3 billion in 12 offerings. The largest is a $626 million New York City deal through Lehman Brothers.
An additional 10 issues totaling $265 million on Reuters possible negotiated calendar, meaning underwriters have said they may priced the deals Tuesday depending on market conditions.
